situations.headline: Livium: Recycling Volume Ramp, VSPC Due-Diligence Progress, SPP Extension

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Livium: Recycling Volume Ramp, VSPC Due-Diligence Progress, SPP Extension (interest 5, risk 6)

thesis.text: Livium is a small-cap Australian battery/solar recycler (via Envirostream) scaling LIB volumes through customer diversification (Sell & Parker, BYD, CATL, LGES, Hyundai Glovis) while pursuing optionality in solar panel recycling (Won Kwang/Iondrive) and a potential strategic alliance for its VSPC LFP cathode technology with a multinational partner now moving toward due diligence. Near-term catalysts include SPP completion (18 Sept 2026 results) and progress on VSPC due-diligence scope, but the company remains pre-profit at group level, reliant on non-binding partnership discussions, and operates in a volatile, nascent recycling industry, warranting continued monitoring rather than high-conviction sizing.
